name: Wavelet-Based Adaptive Grid Volume Rendering
aliases: Direct summation of wavelet coefficients during volumetric ray casting
Volumetric ray casting of multi-scale datasets in wavelet space
definition: A volume rendering technique that visualizes data represented by a superposition of scaling functions on a coarse regular grid and wavelets on an adaptive mesh, capitalizing on sparse data representation and wavelet compression.
summary: Wavelet-Based Adaptive Grid Volume Rendering visualizes sparse data by superimposing scaling functions on a coarse grid with wavelets on an adaptive mesh, performing visualization directly in wavelet space rather than reconstructing a uniform grid.
